تماسكت (form VI)
# تَمَاسَكْتُ (tamāsaktu) /ta.maː.sak.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# تَمَاسَكْتَ (tamāsakta) /ta.maː.sak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# تَمَاسَكْتِ (tamāsakti) /ta.maː.sak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# تَمَاسَكَتْ (tamāsakat) /ta.maː.sa.kat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
